packages.exploitability: Runtime HTTP dependency used by Discord REST and remote attachment fetch. Hostile/compromised responses can reach decompression and TLS error handling. WebSocket/EventSource/cookie-forwarding/cache-interceptor-specific advisories require those features and are not evidenced in the inspected Discord REST path. Do not assume fixed Discord API origins remove all HTTP/TLS exposure. Application global fetch also depends on the separately installed Node runtime, not this npm override.
packages.compatibility_risk_and_evidence: 6.x override of exact 6.24.1 pins. Real Discord REST adapter and undici fetch pass with a synthetic loopback server. No live Discord, proxy, remote TLS or cross-platform compatibility certification.
packages.disposition: No finding in fresh post-fix npm lockfile audit; upstream parent version retained with targeted transitive fix.

packages.exploitability: Reachable in ONNX native dependency installation through NuGet ZIP entry lookup/extraction. No application handler accepts user ZIPs. Exploitation requires hostile installation ZIP content or a hostile destination filesystem. Memory allocation/decompression and extraction defects apply at installation; asynchronous/whole-archive-only variants are not used by the inspected call path.
packages.compatibility_risk_and_evidence: Cross-minor 0.x override of ONNX ^0.5.16. Tested constructor/getEntry/extractEntryTo against a synthetic NuGet-shaped ZIP. Stricter archive guards can reject malformed packages. No real GPU NuGet download or ONNX model inference performed.
packages.disposition: No finding in fresh post-fix npm lockfile audit; upstream parent version retained with targeted transitive fix.
